name: llama.cpp SYCL + B70 Bolt patch
summary: Upstream llama.cpp 620d2225c (b11669) plus one SYCL patch for Nemotron 3.5 Bolt on Arc Pro B70: fixes the DFlash drafter crash and adds a grouped XMX MoE GEMM path. Built with GGML_SYCL_F16=ON.
notes: Patch file llama.cpp-620d2225c-b70-bolt.patch, sha256 51fe97fd2f76ee04adddcf4fc2c0fcb4158fed49d411edee0145a5b736f972f7, 12 files, including a row-strided OUT_PROD regression test in tests/test-backend-ops.cpp. Built from upstream .devops/intel.Dockerfile, target server, with GGML_SYCL_F16=ON. Public image: ghcr.io/sergiiob/llama.cpp-sycl-b70:b11669-bolt@sha256:c1b871ee87d2790e92605e89d8fa40c41a61afa128bdce55da0f9fba22e3d042 (bundles compute-runtime 26.18). Set GGML_SYCL_GROUPED_MAX_ROWS=0 at run time to use the grouped XMX MoE GEMM at every batch width. Results name the exact revision.
